This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “古代的时候” / Formula: 在 + historical time period / Correct: “在古代”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物” / Formula: Subject + 看到/看见 + object / Correct: “神农正在路上走，看到很多人正在吃一些植物。”
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “一些人一吃植物就生病了” / Formula: 有些人 + 一 + verb phrase + 就 + result; use no “了” for a general/habitual situation / Correct: “有些人一吃某些植物就生病。” “植物” is too broad here, because not every plant makes people sick; “某些植物” is clearer.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “神农想帮别人。所以想知道……” / Formula: Subject + 想 + verb, 所以 + verb phrase / Correct: “神农想帮助人们，所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。” “所以想知道” needs to be connected to the previous clause rather than standing as a separate sentence.

items.reason: “古代的时候” redundantly combines two time expressions under the teacher’s rule, and “在古代” is correct.
The teacher marks “一看” here as needing “看到” (or “一看到”), and the proposed sentence is grammatical.
In this completed story event, “一些人一吃植物就生病了” is acceptable, so changing it into a habitual statement without “了” is not a needed correction.
“别人” incorrectly means other people distinct from the relevant group; “人们” correctly replaces it, though the displayed original cuts off after “想知道”.
